title: Workshop / Lab Exercise
content:
This page is internal and intended as a small workshop / lab exercise to evaluate the new implementation of DORA Metrics version 3.0, which uses a GitHub action instead of a plain script. The page will be archived once the workshop is finished.

Requirements

IPEX Team Octostore requires your help to setup DORA metrics - deployment frequency and change lead time.

The team has a monolithic repository with different planners named "BROR", "BOAXEL", "AURDAL", "JONAXEL", and "IVAR". For each planner they use release branches for release candidate testing. Example names of these release branches are:

  • release/ivar.5.0.x

  • releases/jonaxel-1.6.x

From these release branches they merge to main, so they do not want pull-requests associated with these branches to be part of the DORA metrics implementation.

Their default branch is "main".

All pull-request branches must be prefixed with one of the following prefixes:

  • feature

  • bugfix

  • chore

  • refactor

  • experimental

  • doc

The pull-request branches must also include their product-id, "octo" (lowercase) after the prefix (/).

As a first step the team is only interested in measuring deployments to production. The YAML workflow file that currently performs this is "prod_deploy_akamai.yml". Since the team is new they do not have an Akamai upload account, so only the build step is available in the workflow, but they would still like to implement the DORA metrics in this workflow file.

The team has decided they will figure out a tagging strategy themselves; however, they do not want to include old tags in their changelog. They want to have all changes after the following tag: "PLATFORM5.0"

Furthermore, the team does not have any own changelog generator, so they need help to setup that part.

Finally, since the team is planning to move all planners except from “BROR”, they want the DORA metrics action to specifically only include merged pull-requests that match “BROR7.*" - nothing else.

Prerequisites

  • DORA Metrics repository with relevant documentation: https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-dora-metrics/tree/feat/pe-1069-convert-to-action-2

  • Repository name for lab exercise: cbf-re-ipex-common-sandbox

  • Since the flag trace_only should be used you do not need to configure the secret environment variable DEVOPS_METRICS_API_KEY. However, the actual specification of the variable needs to be present in the env: context of the action.

  • Since the DORA action code is not yet merged to main, it needs to be called from the following branch: feat/pe-1069-convert-to-action-2

I.e.,

- uses: inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-dora-metrics@feat/pe-1069-convert-to-action-2

instead of

- uses: inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-dora-metrics@main
